description: This PHP source file contains a function 'additionalDetailsEmail' that generates an HTML tooltip string with email details such as sender's name and email body preview, and constructs links for editing or viewing an email record. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, providing additional details for email records.

methods.name: additionalDetailsEmail
methods.description: Generates a tooltip string with email details, including sender info and email body preview, plus related links for editing and viewing the email record.
